mapper.sql: FROM course_schedule s LEFT JOIN course_class c ON s.class_id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN course_category cat ON c.category_id = cat.category_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON s.teacher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN classroom r ON s.classroom_id = r.classroom_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course_schedule WHERE course_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY course_date,start_time
